newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss stocks end volatile session mixed to easier.
newsitem.headline: Swiss stocks end volatile session mixed to easier.

text.p: Swiss shares ended a volatile session mixed to lower on Thursday. Dealers said trade was quiet as investors waited for Friday's CPI and retail data from the U.S.
The blue-chip Swiss Market Index (SMI) fell 8.3 points to 4,626.6 points. The broad Swiss Performance Index (SPI) was down 2.90 points to 2,926.88.
Novartis, down 14 francs to 1,759, led the active list.
Dealers said the share was under pressure from rumors that a competitor had launched a drug in the U.S. which could hurt Novartis.
Nestle, two lower at 1,707 were second.
Clariant, Oerlikon-Buehrle and Sulzer were higher. Dealers said all three firms were doing road shows abroad and were favorabley received.
In the financial sector, Winterthur Insurance and CS Group felt some profit taking after strong rises on Wednesday.
Even CS Group's own CS First Boston recommended its clients use the price jump to take profits in Winterthur.
Winterthur fell 16 to 1,033 Swiss francs and CS Group shed 1.75 to 166.50.
Some traders said there might have been some swapping of Winterthur and CS Group into shares of Zurich Insurance and UBS. UBS gained 16 francs to 1,287 and Zurich added 5.50 to 454.
Second-tier shares saw SIG bearers 50 francs higher at 3,630. Globus gained 29 to 695.
Kuoni, Danzas and Stratec closed lower.
